White Belt Capstone · Observable Verification

## Belt Test, Evidence Log & Pocket Card

You earn White Belt on observable criteria, not on how fearless it felt. Failing a test is not failing the belt—it means repeating one module and testing again.

cards.label: Capstone
cards.title: Three Observable Belt Tests
cards.md:
### Three Observable Belt Tests

| Done | Test | Setting | Observable Pass Criteria |
|---|---|---|---|
|  | **1. The Hold** | 5-min role-play (guilt, diversion, intelligence-flattery) | One boundary held. Zero apologies. Max one reason. Anger felt and named silently, not acted out. |
|  | **2. Office Dojo (Live)** | Medium-stakes work ask or no | Made as a proposal, preference first, followed by a 3-line confirming email. |
|  | **3. Personal Dojo (Live)** | Real boundary or preference with a friend | Delivered warmly with one line about the relationship, plus a warm check-in afterward. |

Belt-to-Belt Handoff · White (W6) → Blue (B1)

### Ready for Blue Belt: Read & Bond

White Belt built your inner floor so you can stay yourself under pressure without apologizing, over-explaining, or exploding. Once all three observable Belt Tests pass and your Evidence Log trends toward fewer apologies and fewer extra reasons, you earn the right to look across the table in **Blue Belt**—because a read taken while bracing is only a projection.

**Artifacts Carried Forward Into Blue Belt:** Your **W1 Tell List** becomes your personal baseline in **B1** (abort any read the instant your own tells fire). Your **W2 Fallback Map** and **W3 Hook Profile** plug directly into **B3** (cross-checking your own hooks while decoding others' positions). Your **W4 Starter Codex** and **W5–W6 Clean Boundaries** power **B3** (Honor + Hold) and **B5** (Period-Not-"But" Empathy Boundary).
